update.bad_version: --version takes a release tag such as v0.9.0 — {raw} is not one
update.no_exe: cannot tell where this moai is — {said}
update.fetch_failed: could not fetch {url} — {said}. Nothing was run
look.not_a_word: `{value}` in `{key}` is not a word — skipped
sheet.not_a_table: `{table}` must be a `[{table}]` table — it is {is}
sheet.not_a_stamp: `{key}` must be a word holding a time — it is {is}
sheet.held: {ids} could not be written — a hand-written value holds their place there; nothing else was held back, and fixing that line lets the next write land them
sheet.spool_left: {said} — merged, but the pending place could not be cleared
sheet.spool_kept: kept the pending place — not all of it could be read; the next write merges it once the reason given with this is gone
sheet.spool_held: kept the pending place — {ids} cannot land in this project's read file: a hand-written value holds their place there; fix that line and the next write merges them
sheet.fallen_place: that file is this run's pending place, taken because the project's place could not be resolved — deleting it drops the marks already in it
sheet.refuse_unparsable: {said} — nothing is written until that is fixed
sheet.refuse_not_ours: these are not {root}'s read marks, so nothing is written — delete the file by hand
sheet.refuse_not_a_table: `{table}` is not a `[{table}]` table ({is}), so no read marks are written — fix it by hand
stats.head: Counted  {kind} {n}
stats.span_none: not measured - none of the {done} done carry a start
stats.span_group: not read for a group - {done} done, measure the members with -e or --milestone
tui.stats.title: statistics
tui.stats.no_target: no project to count — move onto a project or one of its rows
tui.stats.flow_cut: the latest {shown} of {all} fit this width
tui.wiki.no_project: no wiki to read — the explorer is not inside a project
tui.wiki.no_target: no wiki to read — move onto a project or one of its rows
tui.wiki.unread: could not read the wiki of {name} — {why}
tui.wiki.title: wiki
tui.wiki.skipped: {n} not walked — `moai wiki ls` says why
tui.wiki.no_links: this page names no page and no issue, and no page links here
tui.wiki.missing_page: no page {to} in the wiki — the link leads nowhere
tui.wiki.no_heading: {to} has no heading #{anchor} — this is the top of the page
tui.wiki.veiled_filter: {id} is hidden by the filter · {clear} clears it
tui.wiki.no_marks: no link to pick on this page — Enter lists what it names and the pages linking here
tui.wiki.raw_no_marks: the page as written marks no link — SPC v r draws it again, Enter lists the links
wiki.head: Wiki  {dir}  pages {n}
wiki.empty: Wiki  {dir}  no pages yet — the first one goes in {dir}/README.md
wiki.mark_unread: not read — `moai wiki show {slug}` says why
wiki.too_large: {bytes} bytes, over the 1 MB a page is read up to — it stays in the list, the body is not read
wiki.no_dir: No wiki yet — {dir}/ does not exist. The first page goes in {dir}/README.md
wiki.not_a_dir: wiki_dir = "{dir}" is not a directory — fix it in .moai/config.toml
wiki.absolute: wiki_dir = "{dir}" is an absolute path — write a path inside the checkout in .moai/config.toml
wiki.parent: wiki_dir = "{dir}" climbs out with `..` — write a path inside the checkout in .moai/config.toml
wiki.no_page: No page {slug} in {dir}/ — `moai wiki ls` lists the slugs
wiki.skip_not_utf8: the name is not UTF-8, so it cannot be a page
wiki.skip_dir_link: a link to a directory is not followed — the pages behind it are not in the wiki
wiki.notice_missed: Links to a heading the page does not have {n}  {which}
wiki.conflict_raw: Conflict markers — shown as written. Resolve the merge in {path} and commit it
wiki.linked_from_partial: Unread in the wiki {n} — links from there are not counted here; `moai wiki ls` names them
warn.tracking_unknown: Git did not answer whether it tracks this tracker — dotfile rules could not be checked. Fix git or try again
refuse.init_tracking_unknown: Cannot determine whether git tracks this tracker. Fix git and run init again; nothing was planted
refuse.init_driver_without_tracking: --driver requires --tracking commit; a tracker kept out of git has nothing for git to merge
models.unknown_key: `{key}` is not a known model key — ignored
